name: What structural issues are commonly found during tub removals in older Denver homes?

mainEntity.name: What structural issues are commonly found during tub removals in older Denver homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: In older Denver-area homes, tub removals frequently reveal hidden issues such as corroded galvanized plumbing lines, settling-related subfloor rot, or uneven floor joists. Because many regional homes feature non-standard alcove dimensions or dated framing, standard off-the-shelf pans may not fit cleanly. An experienced local contractor will inspect the structural framing and subfloor immediately after tub removal, leveling joists and replacing damaged wood before setting a custom mortar bed or tile surround to guarantee long-term stability and leak prevention.
acceptedAnswer.description: Older local homes often have outdated galvanized pipes, uneven joists from settling, and hidden subfloor moisture damage that must be corrected before installing new tile.
